content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Nick Beres NC5's PostNick Beres NC5 Verified accountFebruary 13 · Shared with PublicGOOD MORNING AND HAPPY FRIDAY THE 13TH. I have to agree with this “Sign of the Times.” Soooo … Friday the 13th is considered an unlucky day in Western superstition. I’ve never found that to be the case. It is just a day — the 13th that falls on a Friday, which happens at least once every year, but can occur up to three times in the same year. That’s the case this year: Today, next month and in November.
